1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device comprises a hardware processor configured to execute instructions that cause the processor to perform said computing.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein said alignment device comprises hardware circuitry distinct from general-purpose computing hardware.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the alignment device is configured to produce a tangible, perceptible change in the user interface display.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting produces a perceptible visual change on the user interface distinct from the documented procedure content itself.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein said alignment device comprises specialized hardware configured to perform said identifying function.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the identification is provided in real-time responsive to the demonstrated user actions.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting is dynamically updated based on the alignment computation.

9. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, wherein the similarity metric computation is performed by specialized hardware distinct from general-purpose processors.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, wherein the previous user experiences are stored in a database and retrieved by the hardware processor to inform the alignment computation.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, wherein the document action extractor comprises hardware configured to parse and extract structural information from the documented procedure.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device comprising a hardware processor configured to compute an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, wherein the highlighting device and scrolling device are configured to produce tangible, perceptible changes in the user interface display.

14. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein the alignment device, highlighting device, and scrolling device are integrated as a unified hardware system configured to perform the guiding function in real-time responsive to demonstrated user actions.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, wherein the hardware processor accesses stored previous user experience data to inform the alignment computation.

17. (Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric using a hardware processor executing instructions that cause the processor to perform said computing.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, wherein the identifying step is performed by specialized hardware configured to process the alignment data.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting produces a perceptible visual change distinct from the documented procedure content.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, wherein the identifying step is performed in real-time responsive to the demonstrated user actions.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is dynamically updated based on the alignment.

22. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, wherein the similarity metric computation is performed by a hardware processor executing specialized instructions.

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, wherein the previous user experiences are retrieved from a database and processed by the hardware processor.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure, wherein the extracting step is performed by a hardware-based parser.

27. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions as recited in claim 17, wherein the program storage device comprises a non-transitory computer-readable medium encoded with instructions that, when executed by a hardware processor, cause the processor to perform the method steps and produce tangible, perceptible changes in a user interface.

28. (Currently amended) A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric using a hardware processor; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment, wherein the highlighting produces a perceptible visual change; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment, wherein the scrolling is performed in real-time responsive to the demonstrated user actions.

29. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein the computing, highlighting, and scrolling steps are performed by an integrated hardware system configured to guide user actions in real-time.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, wherein the previous user experiences are accessed from a database by the hardware processor.

32. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface as recited in claim 28, wherein the program storage device comprises a non-transitory computer-readable medium encoded with instructions that, when executed by a hardware processor, cause the processor to perform the method steps and produce tangible, perceptible changes in the user interface display.
